author: osi1880vr
title: osiworx-pack
description: Osiworx node pack. Module 'layer': token-chunked execution of big DiTs (MiniMax H3, Krea 2) to lower activation memory on long videos / large images. Works together with ComfyUI Dynamic VRAM (--vram-headroom). Module 'wos': Megapixel Size, width/height for a megapixel budget from an input image.
